summary_1line: After defeating a Gandharva, Arjuna hears why they were censured and begins the tale explaining the epithet 'Tapatya' through the story of Surya’s daughter Tapati.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands victorious at night before the defeated Gandharva, who speaks beside his radiant wife under the dark sky.
The sun god Surya beholds the beautiful Tapati, radiant and unmatched in beauty among celestial beings.
King Samvarana performs austere worship to Surya with garlands and offerings while the blazing sun watches from the heavens.
